gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma, Recurrent; Lower Grade Glioma, Recurrent
Histopathologically-confirmed, supratentorial GBM or lower-grade gliomas

candidate_evidence.quote: Recombinant human endostatin was administrated 15mg/d, daily for 14 days.
Recombinant human endostatin (rh-ES) is an endogenous broad-spectrum angiogenesis inhibitor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma, Recurrent; Lower Grade Glioma, Recurrent

role_evidence.quote: Study of Recombinant Human Endostatin Combined with Temozolomide and Irinotecan in Recurrent Gliomas
Temozolomide was given orally 200mg/m2 for 5 days in each cycle.
Irinotecan was administrated 125mg/m2 on day 1 and day 15.

flag.reason: Irinotecan is not a standard GBM therapy; coded as cytotoxic backbone given in every arm (C3), but could be read as a second investigational agent (experimental_combination).

coder_notes: Two EXPERIMENTAL arms defined by histology (glioblastoma; lower-grade glioma) receive the same triplet. Investigational question is the addition of recombinant human endostatin to a temozolomide plus irinotecan chemotherapy regimen ('Combined with Cytotoxic Chemotherapy Regimen'), so temozolomide and irinotecan are coded as background (every arm); endostatin is the candidate either way. Registry arm labels 'glioblastoma:' and 'lower-grade glioma:' have empty descriptions. The registry combines all three drugs into a single intervention entry, split here. Lower-grade glioma arm may include IDH-mutant tumours but the glioblastoma arm and conditions name GBM.
